cc:Work.dc:title: 829 large ships reach Baltimore, 291 km from the entrance: 57% of the 1,461 seen at the entrance
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the Chesapeake Bay to Baltimore route cells shaded by distinct large ships, and a step chart of ships against distance from the entrance; 1,461 ships at the entrance and 829 at Baltimore.
